title: Private Tour to Christmas Winter Village, Bayshore and Hyde Park

requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

Digital Consent forms for all adults will be sent by text or Viator messaging app. Rider consent forms will need to be completed before the tour can start.
We operate one vehicle with a maximum of 5 guests. Duplicate bookings to accommodate additional guests cannot be fulfilled.
policies: Please be aware that our starting point is in close proximity to Amalie Arena and if there are scheduled Hockey Games or Concerts parking may be difficult. Please prepare accordingly so we can start promptly at your scheduled booking time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: By booking our tour, up to five guests are provided pickup, drop off and transportation by a custom Golf Cart between some of the best Christmas Light's and Christmas Events Tampa has to offer. This tour lasts 1.5 hours. This tour provides the transportation in a fun and unique way to see the City of Tampa and experience the Christmas season.
